free_tier.stated: EUR 2.29 per month for DE-BUDGET-1 in Frankfurt: 1 vCPU at 2.7 to 3.7 GHz, 1 GB DDR4, 10 GB NVMe, 125 Mbps port, 4 TB traffic, KVM, 1 IPv4 plus /64 IPv6, basic L3/L4 DDoS protection. Read 2026-11-07 the four Frankfurt budget rows render 'Out of stock' and the four Helsinki rows at the same prices show Order links; on the 2026-10-23 read the reverse held. The budget ladder is EUR 4.49 (2 vCPU / 2 GB / 20 GB / 250 Mbps / 8 TB), EUR 6.59 (3 / 3 / 30 / 375 Mbps / 12 TB) and EUR 8.59 (4 / 4 / 40 / 500 Mbps / 16 TB).
